Ability 3 – Flaming Adze: User condenses their flames into the legendary Adze, creating a living fire-born beast bound to their command. The Adze can fight independently, tear through enemies with blazing attacks, carry the user across the battlefield at extreme speed, or dissolve into flame and reform elsewhere, making it both a powerful summon and a highly versatile companion

Infernia Ability 4 – Firefly Shift: User releases dozens of microscopic flame-fireflies across the battlefield that are nearly invisible to the naked eye. The moment the user senses lethal danger, their body collapses into flame and instantly reforms from any one of the scattered fireflies, essentially allowing them to “teleport” to unpredictable locations; each firefly can only be used once, meaning every escape permanently reduces their remaining options
